idPrivacy.title: Why do we ask for your ID?
idPrivacy.why: We verify identity to protect both customers and providers, and to prevent fake requests.
idPrivacy.who: Only authorised admin staff. Dispatchers and providers cannot see it, and it is not shown back to you after upload.
idPrivacy.storage: Encrypted on our servers, never published at a public URL. Every time it is viewed, who viewed it and when is recorded.
idPrivacy.retention: It is deleted automatically once it is no longer needed, under our data retention policy.
idPrivacy.consent: I agree to upload my ID and to it being processed as described above
